title: Concept: X-Permitted-Cross-Domain-Policies permits every policy file
description: X-Permitted-Cross-Domain-Policies is set to all. The value tells legacy clients that a cross-domain policy file may live anywhere on the origin, removing the restriction on where a permissive policy can be picked up; combined with a forgotten crossdomain.xml it re-opens cross-origin data access.
applicability: Responses consumed by legacy plugin or document clients.
risk: Permissive cross-domain policy loading through legacy clients; LOW severity because modern browsers no longer use the mechanism.
